question.t: 一位初階工程師提交了上述程式碼片段作為表單提交按鈕。
question.en: A junior engineer submitted the above code snippet as a form submission button.

question.t: 除了缺乏鍵盤操作支援（如 Enter/Space 鍵）之外，從「無障礙樹 (Accessibility Tree)」的角度來看，這個實作最主要的問題是什麼？
question.en: Besides lacking keyboard support (e.g., Enter/Space keys), what is the primary issue with this implementation from the perspective of the 'Accessibility Tree'?

options.t: (A) 該元素在 DOM 中不存在，因此螢幕閱讀器完全無法偵測到它。
options.en: (A) The element does not exist in the DOM, so screen readers cannot detect it at all.

options.t: (B) 該元素在無障礙樹中缺乏正確的「角色 (Role)」與「狀態 (State)」，輔助科技僅將其視為通用文字群組。
options.en: (B) The element lacks the correct 'Role' and 'State' in the Accessibility Tree, causing assistive technologies to treat it as a generic text group.

options.t: (C) `div` 標籤會導致瀏覽器停止解析後續的 HTML 結構。
options.en: (C) The `div` tag causes the browser to stop parsing subsequent HTML structure.

options.t: (D) 使用 `onClick` 會強制將該元素從無障礙樹中移除。
options.en: (D) Using `onClick` forces the element to be removed from the Accessibility Tree.

why.t: DOM 節點雖然存在，但若沒有語意化的標籤（如 `<button>`）或顯式的 ARIA 角色，瀏覽器無法將其映射為具備互動屬性的無障礙物件 (A11y Object)。螢幕閱讀器使用者將無法識別這是一個可點擊的按鈕。
why.en: While the DOM node exists, without a semantic tag (like `<button>`) or an explicit ARIA role, the browser cannot map it to an Accessibility Object with interactive properties. Screen reader users will not recognize it as a clickable button.

keywords: SPA, Routing, Focus Management, User Experience

question.t: 在單頁應用程式 (SPA) 中，當使用者點擊導航連結切換路由後，螢幕閱讀器使用者經常抱怨必須重新聽一遍整個頁面的標頭與選單才能讀到新內容。
question.en: In a Single Page Application (SPA), after a user clicks a navigation link to change routes, screen reader users often complain that they have to listen to the entire page header and menu again to reach the new content.

question.t: 這是什麼原因造成的，以及在系統設計層面應如何解決？
question.en: What causes this, and how should it be addressed at the system design level?

options.t: (A) 這是瀏覽器的預設行為；應改用傳統的多頁應用程式 (MPA) 架構。
options.en: (A) This is default browser behavior; traditional Multi-Page Application (MPA) architecture should be used instead.

options.t: (B) 焦點遺失或重置回 `body`；應在路由切換後，以程式化方式將焦點移至新頁面的主標題 (`h1`) 或主要內容容器。
options.en: (B) Focus is lost or reset to `body`; focus should be programmatically moved to the new page's main heading (`h1`) or main content wrapper after the route change.

options.t: (C) 這是因為沒有使用 `aria-live` 屬性；應在整個 `body` 上添加 `aria-live="polite"`。
options.en: (C) This is because the `aria-live` attribute is missing; `aria-live="polite"` should be added to the entire `body`.

options.t: (D) 這是因為使用了 `client-side rendering`；應強制所有連結在新分頁開啟。
options.en: (D) This is due to `client-side rendering`; all links should be forced to open in a new tab.

why.t: 在 SPA 中，DOM 只是局部替換，瀏覽器不會像 MPA 那樣自動重置焦點與閱讀游標。開發者必須在路由轉換完成後，手動管理焦點位置（Focus Management），將其導引至主要內容區域，避免使用者迷失。
why.en: In an SPA, the DOM is only partially replaced, and the browser does not automatically reset focus and the reading cursor like in an MPA. Developers must manually manage focus (Focus Management) after the route transition completes, guiding it to the main content area to prevent users from getting lost.

keywords: Modal, Focus Trap, Keyboard Accessibility, Component Design

question.t: 您正在審查設計系統中的 `Modal` (模態視窗) 元件。
question.en: You are auditing a `Modal` component in the design system.

question.t: 該元件已設定 `role="dialog"` 與 `aria-modal="true"`，但在鍵盤測試中，按下 `Tab` 鍵多次後，焦點會移出視窗並進入背景頁面。
question.en: The component has `role="dialog"` and `aria-modal="true"` set, but during keyboard testing, pressing the `Tab` key repeatedly causes the focus to move out of the modal and into the background page.

question.t: 這違反了哪項關鍵的無障礙互動模式？
question.en: Which key accessibility interaction pattern does this violate?

options.t: (A) Return Focus (歸還焦點)
options.en: (A) Return Focus

options.t: (B) Focus Trap (焦點鎖定)
options.en: (B) Focus Trap

options.t: (C) Aria Labeling (ARIA 標籤)
options.en: (C) Aria Labeling

options.t: (D) Semantic Structure (語意結構)
options.en: (D) Semantic Structure

why.t: 模態視窗開啟時，鍵盤焦點必須被限制（Trap）在視窗內部，防止使用者意外操作到被遮罩覆蓋的背景內容。這是 Modal 元件最核心的無障礙要求之一。
why.en: When a modal is open, keyboard focus must be constrained (Trapped) within the modal to prevent users from accidentally interacting with the background content covered by the mask. This is one of the most core accessibility requirements for Modal components.

keywords: Native First, ARIA, Toggle Switch, Best Practices

question.t: 根據「原生優先 (Native First)」原則與本章節建議，實作一個客製化外觀的「切換開關 (Toggle Switch)」，最穩健且相容性最高的方法是？
question.en: According to the 'Native First' principle and the recommendations in this chapter, what is the most robust and compatible way to implement a custom-styled 'Toggle Switch'?

options.t: (A) 使用 `div` 搭配 `onClick` 事件，並手動切換 CSS class。
options.en: (A) Use a `div` with an `onClick` event and manually toggle CSS classes.

options.t: (B) 使用 `<button>` 元素，並添加 `role="switch"` 與 `aria-checked` 屬性。
options.en: (B) Use a `<button>` element and add `role="switch"` and `aria-checked` attributes.

options.t: (C) 使用視覺隱藏的 `<input type="checkbox">` 搭配 `<label>` 進行樣式化。
options.en: (C) Use a visually hidden `<input type="checkbox">` paired with a `<label>` for styling.

options.t: (D) 使用 `span` 元素並設定 `tabindex="0"`。
options.en: (D) Use a `span` element and set `tabindex="0"`.

why.t: 使用原生的 `<input type="checkbox">` 可以讓瀏覽器自動處理狀態邏輯、鍵盤事件與表單提交，無需依賴 JavaScript 維護 ARIA 狀態，符合「最穩健 (Best Approach)」的實作建議。
why.en: Using a native `<input type="checkbox">` allows the browser to automatically handle state logic, keyboard events, and form submission without relying on JavaScript to maintain ARIA state, aligning with the 'Best Approach' implementation recommendation.

question.t: 在 Code Review 中，你發現開發者為了調整 Tab 順序，將按鈕設定為 `tabindex="1"`。
question.en: During a Code Review, you notice a developer set a button to `tabindex="1"` to adjust the Tab order.

question.t: 為什麼這被視為一種反模式 (Anti-pattern)？
question.en: Why is this considered an Anti-pattern?

options.t: (A) 正值的 `tabindex` 會導致該元素在 Tab 順序中被排到「最前面」，破壞了自然的 DOM 順序邏輯，造成跳躍式的導航體驗。
options.en: (A) A positive `tabindex` forces the element to the 'front' of the Tab order, breaking the natural DOM flow logic and creating a jumping navigation experience.

options.t: (B) `tabindex` 屬性在 HTML5 中已被棄用。
options.en: (B) The `tabindex` attribute is deprecated in HTML5.

options.t: (C) 設定 `tabindex` 會導致螢幕閱讀器忽略該元素的文字內容。
options.en: (C) Setting `tabindex` causes screen readers to ignore the text content of the element.

options.t: (D) 正值的 `tabindex` 只能用於 `input` 元素，不能用於 `button`。
options.en: (D) A positive `tabindex` can only be used on `input` elements, not on `button`.

why.t: 大於 0 的 `tabindex` 會將元素移至 Tab 序列的開頭（優先於預設順序的元素），這通常會導致維護困難以及對鍵盤使用者極度困惑的導航順序。應修正 DOM 結構而非強行修改索引。
why.en: A `tabindex` greater than 0 moves the element to the start of the Tab sequence (prioritizing it over default-ordered elements), which usually leads to maintenance difficulties and a highly confusing navigation order for keyboard users. The DOM structure should be fixed instead of forcing index modifications.

keywords: ARIA, Labeling, Accessibility Tree, Best Practices

question.t: 您有一個僅包含「放大鏡圖示 (Icon)」的搜尋按鈕，沒有可見文字。
question.en: You have a search button containing only a 'magnifying glass icon' and no visible text.

question.t: 為了確保螢幕閱讀器能正確讀出 "Search"，下列哪種做法最合適？
question.en: To ensure screen readers correctly announce "Search", which of the following approaches is most appropriate?

options.t: (A) 在按鈕內的 SVG 元素上添加 `alt="Search"`。
options.en: (A) Add `alt="Search"` to the SVG element inside the button.

options.t: (B) 在 `<button>` 元素上添加 `aria-label="Search"`。
options.en: (B) Add `aria-label="Search"` to the `<button>` element.

options.t: (C) 使用 `placeholder="Search"` 屬性。
options.en: (C) Use the `placeholder="Search"` attribute.

options.t: (D) 在按鈕上添加 `role="search"`。
options.en: (D) Add `role="search"` to the button.

why.t: `aria-label` 專門用於當元素缺乏可見文字標籤時，直接為無障礙樹提供字串名稱。SVG 的 `alt` 屬性支援度不一，且 `role` 僅定義角色而非名稱。
why.en: `aria-label` is specifically designed to provide a string name directly to the Accessibility Tree when an element lacks a visible text label. The `alt` attribute on SVG has inconsistent support, and `role` defines what the element is, not its name.

question.t: 您正在實作一個帶有說明文字的密碼輸入欄位（如上方程式碼所示）。
question.en: You are implementing a password input field with helper text (as shown in the code snippet above).

question.t: 為了確保螢幕閱讀器能依序正確讀出「標籤」、「輸入框角色」以及「說明文字」，下列哪一種 ARIA 配置是最佳實務？
question.en: To ensure screen readers correctly announce the 'Label', 'Input Role', and 'Helper Text' in sequence, which ARIA configuration is the best practice?

options.t: (A) 在 input 上使用 `aria-label="Password Must be at least 8 characters"`。
options.en: (A) Use `aria-label="Password Must be at least 8 characters"` on the input.

options.t: (B) 在 input 上設定 `aria-labelledby="lbl_pw"` 與 `aria-describedby="pw_hint"`。
options.en: (B) Set `aria-labelledby="lbl_pw"` and `aria-describedby="pw_hint"` on the input.

options.t: (C) 將說明文字放入 input 的 `placeholder` 屬性中。
options.en: (C) Put the helper text into the `placeholder` attribute of the input.

options.t: (D) 將說明文字放入 input 的 `title` 屬性中。
options.en: (D) Put the helper text into the `title` attribute of the input.

why.t: `aria-describedby` 專門用於關聯額外的描述資訊（如錯誤訊息或提示），它會在標籤與角色讀完後被讀出；而 `aria-label` 會完全覆蓋可見標籤，可能導致資訊遺漏。
why.en: `aria-describedby` is specifically designed to associate additional descriptive information (like error messages or hints), which is announced after the label and role; whereas `aria-label` would completely override the visible label, potentially causing information loss.

keywords: Clean Code, HTML5, Redundant ARIA, Best Practices

question.t: 在進行程式碼審查（Code Review）時，您看到了上述的 HTML 結構。
question.en: During a Code Review, you encounter the HTML structure shown above.

question.t: 根據現代 HTML5 標準與無障礙最佳實務，這段程式碼主要存在什麼問題？
question.en: According to modern HTML5 standards and accessibility best practices, what is the primary issue with this code?

options.t: (A) 缺少 `aria-label`，導致導航區塊無法被識別。
options.en: (A) Missing `aria-label`, causing the navigation block to be unrecognizable.

options.t: (B) 使用了「冗餘的 ARIA (Redundant ARIA)」，增加了程式碼雜訊但未提供額外價值。
options.en: (B) Uses 'Redundant ARIA', adding code noise without providing additional value.

options.t: (C) `<header>` 應該使用 `role="header"` 而不是 `role="banner"`。
options.en: (C) `<header>` should use `role="header"` instead of `role="banner"`.

options.t: (D) 按鈕缺少 `tabindex="0"`，無法被聚焦。
options.en: (D) The button is missing `tabindex="0"` and cannot be focused.

why.t: HTML5 的 `<header>`, `<nav>`, `<button>` 已經具有隱含的語意角色（Implicit Roles）；顯式地重複宣告這些角色（如 `role="navigation"`）是多餘的，應保持程式碼簡潔。
why.en: HTML5 elements like `<header>`, `<nav>`, and `<button>` already have implicit semantic roles; explicitly redeclaring these roles (e.g., `role="navigation"`) is redundant and the code should be kept clean.

question.t: 為了提升 SEO 排名並優化螢幕閱讀器使用者的導航效率，您決定重構網站的佈局結構。
question.en: To improve SEO rankings and optimize navigation efficiency for screen reader users, you decide to refactor the website's layout structure.

question.t: 下列哪一種 HTML 標籤組合最能正確定義頁面的「地標 (Landmarks)」？
question.en: Which of the following HTML tag combinations best defines the page's 'Landmarks'?

options.t: (A) 使用 `<div id="header">`, `<div id="main">`, `<div id="footer">`。
options.en: (A) Use `<div id="header">`, `<div id="main">`, `<div id="footer">`.

options.t: (B) 使用 `<header>`, `<main>`, `<footer>` 以及 `<nav>`, `<aside>`。
options.en: (B) Use `<header>`, `<main>`, `<footer>`, along with `<nav>` and `<aside>`.

options.t: (C) 使用大量的 `<h1>` 到 `<h6>` 來區分區塊。
options.en: (C) Use extensive `<h1>` to `<h6>` tags to distinguish sections.

options.t: (D) 使用 `<section role="region" aria-label="...">` 包裹所有內容。
options.en: (D) Wrap all content using `<section role="region" aria-label="...">`.

why.t: 使用原生的語意化標籤（如 `<main>`, `<nav>`）能自動建立無障礙地標，讓螢幕閱讀器使用者能快速跳轉至主要內容或導航區，同時也能幫助搜尋引擎理解頁面結構。
why.en: Using native semantic tags (like `<main>`, `<nav>`) automatically creates accessibility landmarks, allowing screen reader users to quickly jump to primary content or navigation areas, while also helping search engines understand the page structure.

keywords: Keyboard Events, Interaction, JavaScript, Custom Components

question.t: 您使用上述程式碼實作了一個客製化按鈕。
question.en: You implemented a custom button using the code above.

question.t: QA 團隊回報：雖然可以使用 Tab 鍵聚焦該按鈕，但按下 Enter 鍵或空白鍵 (Space) 時卻沒有任何反應。
question.en: The QA team reports: Although the button can be focused using the Tab key, pressing the Enter key or Space bar triggers no response.

question.t: 這是什麼原因造成的？
question.en: What is the cause of this?

options.t: (A) 缺少 `aria-pressed="true"` 屬性。
options.en: (A) Missing the `aria-pressed="true"` attribute.

options.t: (B) `tabindex="0"` 應該改為 `tabindex="1"` 才能接受鍵盤事件。
options.en: (B) `tabindex="0"` should be changed to `tabindex="1"` to accept keyboard events.

options.t: (C) 非原生的互動元素（如 `div`）不會自動將鍵盤按鍵映射為 `click` 事件，必須手動監聽 `onKeyDown`。
options.en: (C) Non-native interactive elements (like `div`) do not automatically map keyboard keys to `click` events; you must manually listen for `onKeyDown`.

options.t: (D) CSS 樣式缺少 `cursor: pointer`，導致瀏覽器判定其不可點擊。
options.en: (D) The CSS style is missing `cursor: pointer`, causing the browser to determine it as unclickable.

why.t: 原生 `<button>` 會自動處理 Enter 與 Space 鍵並觸發 click 事件；但使用 `div` 模擬時，開發者必須自行撰寫 JavaScript 來監聽 `onKeyDown` 事件並檢查按鍵代碼。
why.en: Native `<button>` elements automatically handle Enter and Space keys and trigger click events; however, when simulating with a `div`, developers must write JavaScript to listen for `onKeyDown` events and check the key codes.

question.t: 您的專案在 CI/CD 流程中整合了 Lighthouse 與 axe-core，且每次掃描都獲得 100 分。
question.en: Your project has integrated Lighthouse and axe-core in the CI/CD pipeline, achieving a score of 100 on every scan.

question.t: 然而，一位視障使用者回報他無法完成結帳流程，因為在開啟「選擇地址」的模態視窗 (Modal) 後，焦點跑到了背景頁面。
question.en: However, a visually impaired user reports being unable to complete the checkout process because after opening the 'Select Address' modal, the focus moved to the background page.

question.t: 這個案例說明了自動化測試工具的什麼限制？
question.en: What limitation of automated testing tools does this case illustrate?

options.t: (A) 自動化工具只能檢測語法錯誤（如缺少標籤、對比度不足），無法驗證邏輯性的焦點管理與互動行為。
options.en: (A) Automated tools can only detect syntactic errors (like missing labels, insufficient contrast) and cannot verify logical focus management and interaction behaviors.

options.t: (B) Lighthouse 與 axe-core 不支援測試 Modal 元件。
options.en: (B) Lighthouse and axe-core do not support testing Modal components.

options.t: (C) CI/CD 環境通常沒有圖形介面，因此無法測試 CSS 相關屬性。
options.en: (C) CI/CD environments usually lack a graphical interface, so CSS-related attributes cannot be tested.

options.t: (D) 這是因為沒有設定 `aria-modal="true"`，自動化工具預設會忽略它。
options.en: (D) This is because `aria-modal="true"` was not set, so automated tools ignore it by default.

why.t: 自動化工具能捕捉約 30-50% 的問題（主要是靜態分析），但像「焦點鎖定 (Focus Trap)」或「焦點歸還」這類依賴 JavaScript 邏輯與時間序列的行為，必須透過手動測試或專門的整合測試來驗證。
why.en: Automated tools can catch about 30-50% of issues (mostly static analysis), but behaviors like 'Focus Trap' or 'Focus Return' that rely on JavaScript logic and timing must be verified through manual testing or specialized integration tests.

keywords: CSS, Hiding Content, Screen Readers, sr-only

question.t: 為了讓螢幕閱讀器使用者能理解一個僅有圖示的按鈕，開發者在按鈕內加入了一個 `<span>` 標籤並套用了上述 CSS 類別，希望將文字在視覺上隱藏但在無障礙樹中保留。
question.en: To allow screen reader users to understand an icon-only button, a developer added a `<span>` tag inside the button and applied the CSS class above, hoping to hide the text visually but keep it in the Accessibility Tree.

question.t: 請問這種做法會導致什麼後果？
question.en: What is the consequence of this approach?

options.t: (A) 這是正確的做法，螢幕閱讀器仍能讀取該文字。
options.en: (A) This is the correct approach; screen readers can still read the text.

options.t: (B) 該文字會從無障礙樹中被移除，導致螢幕閱讀器無法讀取。
options.en: (B) The text will be removed from the Accessibility Tree, rendering it unreadable to screen readers.

options.t: (C) 只有 `visibility: hidden` 會移除內容，`display: none` 仍會保留。
options.en: (C) Only `visibility: hidden` removes content; `display: none` preserves it.

options.t: (D) 螢幕閱讀器會讀取文字，但會提示使用者該文字是隱藏的。
options.en: (D) Screen readers will read the text but warn the user that it is hidden.

why.t: `display: none` 與 `visibility: hidden` 都會將元素從無障礙樹 (Accessibility Tree) 中完全移除。若要實現「視覺隱藏但機器可讀」，應使用 CSS 的 `clip` 或絕對定位技術（如教材中的 `.sr-only` 模式）。
why.en: Both `display: none` and `visibility: hidden` completely remove the element from the Accessibility Tree. To achieve 'visually hidden but machine-readable', one should use CSS `clip` or absolute positioning techniques (like the `.sr-only` pattern in the material).

question.t: 您正在實作一個「手風琴 (Accordion)」收合元件。
question.en: You are implementing a collapsible 'Accordion' component.

question.t: 當使用者點擊按鈕展開內容時，除了切換 CSS 類別外，為了符合無障礙標準並正確傳達狀態，您必須在 `<button>` 上動態更新哪個 ARIA 屬性？
question.en: When a user clicks the button to expand content, besides toggling CSS classes, which ARIA attribute must you dynamically update on the `<button>` to comply with accessibility standards and correctly convey state?

options.t: (A) `aria-hidden`
options.en: (A) `aria-hidden`

options.t: (B) `aria-live`
options.en: (B) `aria-live`

options.t: (C) `aria-expanded`
options.en: (C) `aria-expanded`

options.t: (D) `aria-selected`
options.en: (D) `aria-selected`

why.t: `aria-expanded` 是專門用來告知輔助科技該控制元件所控制的區域目前是「展開 (true)」還是「收合 (false)」狀態的屬性。`aria-hidden` 通常用於內容容器而非觸發按鈕。
why.en: `aria-expanded` is the attribute specifically designed to inform assistive technologies whether the region controlled by the widget is currently 'expanded (true)' or 'collapsed (false)'. `aria-hidden` is typically used on the content container, not the trigger button.

question.t: 設計團隊認為瀏覽器預設的藍色焦點框 (Focus Ring) 破壞了美感，要求您將其移除。
question.en: The design team feels that the browser's default blue focus ring ruins the aesthetics and asks you to remove it.

question.t: 您在全域 CSS 中加入了上述程式碼。請問這對無障礙體驗有何嚴重影響？
question.en: You added the above code to the global CSS. What serious impact does this have on the accessibility experience?

options.t: (A) 螢幕閱讀器將無法聚焦到任何元素。
options.en: (A) Screen readers will be unable to focus on any elements.

options.t: (B) 鍵盤使用者將無法在視覺上確認當前操作的位置，導致網站幾乎無法使用。
options.en: (B) Keyboard users will be unable to visually confirm their current location, rendering the site nearly unusable.

options.t: (C) 這只會影響美觀，並不違反 WCAG 標準。
options.en: (C) This only affects aesthetics and does not violate WCAG standards.

options.t: (D) 瀏覽器會自動強制覆蓋此設定，因此沒有實際影響。
options.en: (D) The browser will automatically override this setting, so there is no actual impact.

why.t: 移除 `outline` 且未提供替代樣式（如 `box-shadow` 或 `border` 變化）會使依賴鍵盤導航的使用者完全迷失方向。正確做法是設計符合品牌風格的可見焦點樣式，而非單純移除。
why.en: Removing `outline` without providing an alternative style (like `box-shadow` or `border` changes) causes keyboard users to completely lose track of their navigation. The correct approach is to design a visible focus style that matches the brand, rather than simply removing it.

question.t: 在計算無障礙名稱 (Accessible Name) 時，瀏覽器會遵循特定的優先順序。
question.en: When calculating the Accessible Name, browsers follow a specific order of precedence.

question.t: 針對上述按鈕，螢幕閱讀器最終會讀出什麼內容？
question.en: For the button above, what content will the screen reader ultimately announce?

options.t: (B) "Close Menu"
options.en: (B) "Close Menu"

options.t: (C) "X, Close Menu"
options.en: (C) "X, Close Menu"

options.t: (D) "Close Menu, X"
options.en: (D) "Close Menu, X"

why.t: 當元素具有 `aria-label` 時，其值會完全覆蓋元素的內部文字內容。因此，螢幕閱讀器只會讀出 "Close Menu"，而 "X" 會被忽略。這是使用 `aria-label` 時需特別注意的行為。
why.en: When an element has an `aria-label`, its value completely overrides the element's inner text content. Therefore, the screen reader will only announce 'Close Menu', and 'X' will be ignored. This is a behavior to be especially aware of when using `aria-label`.
